_meta.rule: Translate every value. Keep labels concise enough for the existing whiteboard layout.

translations.《生产级多智能体系统》第 01 章架构图，使用确定性白板线框表达控制流、证据或责: Chapter 01 architecture diagram for Production-Grade Multi-Agent Systems, using deterministic whiteboard line art to show control flow, evidence, and responsibility boundaries.
translations.共享确定性控制面：身份 · 租户 · 状态 · 规则 · 幂等 · 审计 · O: Shared deterministic control plane: Identity · Tenant · State · Rules · Idempotency · Audit · Outbox · Approval
translations.观察结果必须改变下一动作；权限、执行、状态与终止不交给模型自由发挥。: Observations must change the next action; permissions, execution, state, and termination stay outside model discretion.
translations.规划自治决定“下一步谁选”；执行自治决定“系统允许改变什么”。: Planning autonomy decides “who selects next”; execution autonomy decides “what the system may change.”
translations.架构升级靠证据推动，不靠名词推动: Architecture escalation is evidence-driven, not terminology-driven
translations.矩阵不是成熟度排行：规划空间扩大时，执行权限不必同步扩大。: This is not a maturity ranking: broader planning need not mean broader execution.
translations.每增加一层自治，都要说明上一层为什么无法满足需求。: Each added autonomy layer must explain why the previous layer cannot meet the need.
translations.模型主要参与认知；运行时必须让目标、行动、状态与控制保持一致。: The model drives cognition; the runtime must align goals, actions, state, and control.
translations.任务状态 · 记忆 · 知识 · 证据 · 轨迹: Task state · Memory · Knowledge · Evidence · Trace
translations.若边界无法独立测试，拆分通常只会增加协调成本。: If a boundary cannot be tested independently, splitting usually adds only coordination cost.
translations.三种方案共享同一确定性控制面；区别不在有没有数据库，而在谁选择调查路径。: All three options share one deterministic control plane; they differ only in who selects the investigation path.
translations.生产 Agent 的五层结构：责任清楚，系统才可治理: Five layers of a production agent: clarity enables governance
translations.完成 · 证据不足 · 拒绝 · 等待审批 · 转人工: Done · Evidence gap · Refuse · Approval wait · Handoff
translations.五层不等于五个服务；它们是必须被分配、验证和观察的五组工程责任。: Five layers ≠ five services; each is an engineering responsibility to assign, verify, and observe.
translations.先找责任差异，再起角色名称；Prompt 数量不是架构边界。: Find responsibility differences before naming roles; prompt count is not an architectural boundary.
translations.值得拆分的 Agent，必须对应真实工程边界: Split agents only at real engineering boundaries
translations.状态、测试、安全与运维成本上升: State, testing, security, and operational costs rise
translations.自治有两条轴：会规划，不等于可以执行: Autonomy has two axes: planning does not imply permission to act
translations.Agent 的最小闭环：模型选路，运行时控场: The agent's minimal loop: model chooses, runtime controls
translations.CaseOps 三种方案：动态调查责任放在哪里？: Three CaseOps options: where does dynamic investigation reside?
